source: Garg, Crosta and Baier, The Jagged Global Economy: Frontier AI Unevenly Exposes National Economies (2026)

label: Mobile data · 5 GB minimum
source: ITU ICT Price Baskets, December 2025 release
note: ITU 2025 retail basket, selected under its representative-operator rules. At least 5 GB; actual allowance may be higher. Historical observation, not a current quote. Retail basket prices collected under ITU rules; country prices are published in USD and as a share of monthly GNI per capita. Basket definitions changed in 2025.
limit: Historical retail basket; excludes device costs.
